title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in Colombia, implemented by partners ABColombia, CCEEU, Colombia Diversa, CCAJAR, Corambiente, PBI, Sisma Mujer and CCALP, supports communities, survivors of the internal armed conflict and human rights defenders to exercise their rights and live in a more peaceful and equitable society. The objectives of the grant are to support land and human rights defenders and women and marginalised groups to access their rights, including under provisions of the 2016 Peace Agreement, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society. Objectives: Objective 1 - Rights Holders: Rights holders (women, men, groups, organisations, communities and peoples) are taking action to advance their rights Outcomes: Communities, survivors of the internal armed conflict and human rights defenders (with a particular focus on women, different ethnic groups and other marginalised groups) exercise their rights and live in a more peaceful and equitable society where positive commitments and actions are being made to implement the provisions of the 2016 Peace Agreement
